name: Oracle Cloud (OKE) Plugin (WIP)
description: WIP: help appreciated. OKE CLI sign-in and cluster discovery. Browser authentication and reconnect require real OCI validation; node columns, pricing and cost cards are not implemented.

actions.title: Sign in to Oracle Cloud for this cluster (oci session authenticate)…

settings.label: OCI config profile
settings.help: The profile in ~/.oci/config that the cluster's kubeconfig helper uses. The sign-in refreshes this profile's session token.

settings.label: Extra variables for commands and terminals
settings.help: One NAME=value per line, added to the environment of the kubectl and helm commands, the terminals Klotse starts and Klotse's own connection for a cluster, for example OCI_CLI_PROFILE=work. Saved as plain text in the settings file: do not put secrets here. Klotse's own connection to the cluster gets them too (the kubeconfig's sign-in helper), and they are never written to the kubeconfig or logs.

cluster_settings.label: Cloud of this cluster
cluster_settings.help: Set this when the cluster's nodes do not report their cloud in the providerID (a local emulator, a custom node pool). auto uses the providerID check; oci accepts this cluster's nodes without it.
